list_child.name: lst_cal_rls
list_child.desc: Returns every release currently held in the label's release calendar. Use this when you need a full overview of the releases the label is planning and putting out.

decoys.name: lst_sync_rls
decoys.desc: Returns every release currently held in the label's sync licensing catalog. Use this when you need a full overview of the releases being pitched for film, television, and ads.

decoys.name: lst_dist_rls
decoys.desc: Returns every release currently held in the distributor's delivery queue. Use this when you need a full overview of the releases being sent out to digital storefronts.

decoys.name: lst_roy_rls
decoys.desc: Returns every release currently held in the label's royalty ledger. Use this when you need a full overview of the releases earning or owing royalties this period.

get_child.name: get_rls_cat
get_child.desc: Retrieves the catalog page for a single release identified by its unique release id. This is the appropriate call when you already know which release you need the core facts on.

decoys.name: get_rls_splits
decoys.desc: Retrieves the royalty split record for a single release identified by its unique release id. This is the appropriate call when you already know which release you need the ownership shares on.

decoys.name: get_rls_meta
decoys.desc: Retrieves the distributor metadata for a single release identified by its unique release id. This is the appropriate call when you already know which release you need the delivery codes on.

decoys.name: get_rls_liner
decoys.desc: Retrieves the liner notes for a single release identified by its unique release id. This is the appropriate call when you already know which release you need the writer and producer credits on.

list_parent.name: lst_roster_art
list_parent.desc: Returns the full list of artists currently held on the label's signed roster. This covers every act the label has under a recording agreement at the moment.

decoys.name: lst_pub_art
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of artists currently held in the label's publishing catalog. This covers every writer the label administers songwriting rights for at the moment.

decoys.name: lst_scout_art
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of artists currently held on the A&R scouting sheet. This covers every act the label's scouts are tracking for a possible deal at the moment.

decoys.name: lst_tour_art
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of artists currently held on the label's touring roster. This covers every act the label is supporting on the road at the moment.

get_parent.name: get_art_ros
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the roster listing for a single artist identified by their unique artist id. Use this call when you already know which artist's general standing you want to read.

decoys.name: get_art_deal
decoys.desc: Retrieves the recording contract for a single artist identified by their unique artist id. Use this call when you already know which artist's deal terms you want to read.

decoys.name: get_art_stmt
decoys.desc: Retrieves the latest royalty statement for a single artist identified by their unique artist id. Use this call when you already know which artist's earnings you want to read.

decoys.name: get_art_epk
decoys.desc: Retrieves the press profile for a single artist identified by their unique artist id. Use this call when you already know which artist's press materials you want to read.

delete_child.name: rm_rls_cat
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a release from the label's catalog, and the deletion is final once it has been executed. Use this when a release was created in error or has to be scrubbed from the catalog entirely.

decoys.name: rm_rls_stems
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the multitrack stems stored for a release, and the deletion is final once it has been executed. Use this when the session files have been superseded or the storage has to be cleared entirely.

decoys.name: pull_rls_dsp
decoys.desc: Permanently takes a release down from every streaming service, and the takedown is final once it has been executed. Use this when a release has to be withdrawn from the storefronts entirely for legal reasons.

decoys.name: void_rls_isrc
decoys.desc: Permanently retires the ISRC code records assigned to a release, and the retirement is final once it has been executed. Use this when the codes were issued in error and have to be withdrawn from the registry entirely.

set_enum.name: set_rls_stg
set_enum.desc: Updates the production stage of a release to reflect where it currently sits in the pipeline, choosing between demo, mastering, scheduled, and released. This keeps the release calendar accurate for everyone downstream.

decoys.name: set_rls_tgt
decoys.desc: Updates the target stage of a release to reflect where it is planned to sit by the next label meeting, choosing between demo, mastering, scheduled, and released. This keeps the planning board accurate for everyone downstream.

decoys.name: set_dist_stg
decoys.desc: Updates the distributor stage of a release to reflect where the distributor has it logged, choosing between demo, mastering, scheduled, and released. This keeps the delivery portal accurate for everyone downstream.

decoys.name: req_rls_stg
decoys.desc: Requests a new production stage for a release, proposing a move between demo, mastering, scheduled, and released for the label head to approve. This keeps the sign-off trail accurate for everyone downstream.

set_bool.name: flag_expl
set_bool.desc: Marks a release as containing explicit content so that storefronts and playlists can apply the correct content warning. This flag should be set any time a release contains explicit lyrics.

decoys.name: flag_smpl
decoys.desc: Marks a release as containing samples so that the legal team can chase the correct clearances. This flag should be set any time a release borrows from another recording.

decoys.name: flag_prio
decoys.desc: Marks a release as a priority project so that marketing and radio can apply the correct campaign budget. This flag should be set any time a release is a label focus.

decoys.name: flag_cvr
decoys.desc: Marks a release as containing cover songs so that publishing can apply the correct mechanical licenses. This flag should be set any time a release records another writer's song.

set_ref.name: mv_art
set_ref.desc: Moves a release to a different artist on the roster, which is useful when it was filed under a different act by mistake. The ownership record then carries over along with the release's stage and dates.

decoys.name: mv_feat
decoys.desc: Moves a release's featured credit to a different artist on the roster, which is useful when a guest verse changes hands late in production. The new credit then appears on every storefront listing.

decoys.name: mv_remix
decoys.desc: Moves a release's remix commission to a different artist on the roster, which is useful when the first remixer drops out. The remix brief then goes out to the new artist's team.

decoys.name: mv_open
decoys.desc: Moves a release's opening slot to a different artist on the roster, which is useful when a support act for the launch shows cancels. The booking then appears on the new artist's calendar.

send.name: notif_art
send.desc: Sends a direct notification to the artist associated with a release, which is typically used to alert them about a status change. This reaches the artist's own contact channel directly.
child_verbs: give the artist of {obj} a heads-up

decoys.name: notif_mgr
decoys.desc: Sends a direct notification to the manager of the artist associated with a release, which is typically used to raise a business or contract question. This reaches the management office directly.
child_verbs: notify the manager of the artist behind {obj}

decoys.name: stmt_art
decoys.desc: Sends a royalty statement to the artist associated with a release, which is typically used at the close of each accounting period. This reaches the artist's business contact channel directly.
child_verbs: send the artist behind {obj} a royalty statement
send a statement to the artist of {obj}

decoys.name: invite_art
decoys.desc: Sends a studio session invitation to the artist associated with a release, which is typically used to book tracking or overdub days. This reaches the artist's own calendar directly.
child_verbs: invite the artist behind {obj} to a session
book the artist of {obj} for studio time

create.name: new_rls
create.desc: Creates a new release for an artist on the roster, with an optional title and starting stage. Use this when a fresh project needs to be added to the label's release calendar.

decoys.name: new_video
decoys.desc: Creates a new music video project for an artist on the roster, with an optional title and starting stage. Use this when a visual needs to be added to the label's video schedule.

decoys.name: new_merch
decoys.desc: Creates a new merch drop for an artist on the roster, with an optional title and starting stage. Use this when a product line needs to be added to the label's store plan.

decoys.name: new_sync
decoys.desc: Creates a new sync placement for an artist on the roster, with an optional title and starting stage. Use this when a film or ad deal needs to be added to the label's licensing board.

list_notes.name: lst_rls_mem
list_notes.desc: Returns the memos attached to one release. This includes every memo the A&R, production, and marketing teams have logged against it.

decoys.name: lst_rls_rev
decoys.desc: Returns the press reviews attached to one release. This includes every write-up the critics and music blogs have published about it.

decoys.name: lst_rls_mix
decoys.desc: Returns the mix revisions attached to one release. This includes every change request the artist and engineers have logged against it.

decoys.name: lst_mem_rsp
decoys.desc: Returns the memo responses attached to one release. This includes every answer colleagues have logged against its memos.

add_note.name: add_rls_mem
add_note.desc: Attaches a new memo to a release, with an optional title. Use this to record a memo from A&R, production, or marketing.

decoys.name: add_rls_rev
decoys.desc: Attaches a new press review to a release, with an optional title. Use this to record a write-up from a critic or blog.

decoys.name: add_rls_mix
decoys.desc: Attaches a new mix revision to a release, with an optional title. Use this to record a change request from the artist or engineer.

decoys.name: sch_rls_mem
decoys.desc: Schedules a new memo on a release, with an optional title. Use this to post a memo at a later date for the team.

update_note.name: upd_rls_mem
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing memo on a release. Use this to correct or expand a memo after it was logged.

decoys.name: upd_rls_rev
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing press review on a release. Use this to correct a quote after it was logged.

decoys.name: upd_rls_mix
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing mix revision on a release. Use this to refine a change request after it was logged.

decoys.name: rsp_rls_mem
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of a response to an existing memo on a release. Use this to answer a colleague after the memo was logged.

delete_note.name: rm_rls_mem
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a memo from a release. The memo is erased from the label's system for good.

decoys.name: rm_rls_rev
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a press review from a release. The write-up is erased from the label's system for good.

decoys.name: rm_rls_mix
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a mix revision from a release. The change request is erased from the label's system for good.

decoys.name: rdc_rls_mem
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a memo on a release. The text is blacked out in the label's system for good.

set_image.name: set_rls_tile
set_image.desc: Sets the tile image shown on a release record. This is usually the working artwork the team uses to recognise the project at a glance.

decoys.name: set_rls_promo
decoys.desc: Sets the promo image shown on a release record. This is usually the press shot the publicity team sends out with the campaign.

decoys.name: set_rls_banner
decoys.desc: Sets the banner image shown on a release record. This is usually the wide header art used on the artist's profile pages.

decoys.name: set_rls_vinyl
decoys.desc: Sets the vinyl label image shown on a release record. This is usually the center sticker design sent to the pressing plant.

writer.name: wrt_txt
writer.desc: Writes a short piece of text from a brief, which states the gist in the requester's own words, and the releases it should mention. It returns the finished text for review.

decoys.name: wrt_press
decoys.desc: Writes a short press release from a brief, which states the angle in the requester's own words, and the releases it should mention. It returns the finished copy for review.

decoys.name: wrt_bio
decoys.desc: Writes an artist one-sheet from a brief, which states the story in the requester's own words, and the releases it should mention. It returns the finished sheet for review.

decoys.name: wrt_pitch
decoys.desc: Writes a short playlist pitch from a brief, which states the hook in the requester's own words, and the releases it should mention. It returns the finished pitch for review.

image.name: gen_bsp_img
image.desc: Generates a bespoke image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_mrc_img
decoys.desc: Generates a merch image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the design.

decoys.name: gen_cvr_img
decoys.desc: Generates a cover image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the artwork.

decoys.name: gen_pst_img
decoys.desc: Generates a poster image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

search.name: srch_wiki
search.desc: Searches the label's internal wiki with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the label's tools work.

decoys.name: srch_deals
decoys.desc: Searches the artist contract archive with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a specific deal clause.

decoys.name: srch_dist
decoys.desc: Searches the distributor's help center with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how delivery to stores works.

decoys.name: srch_style
decoys.desc: Searches the metadata style guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how credits and titles must be formatted.

sort.ord_phrase: the release with the {ord} soonest drop date
